scope: Short agent-style questions on four public pinned repositories (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust). The repositories were seen in earlier workflow packs. The questions are new; some label files also label different questions in earlier sets (label_files_in_earlier_sets). Neither arm was tuned on them. Authored, non-exhaustive labels, not independent users or agent outcomes. Frozen before any hosted rerank call; one dispatch, no tuning, consumed after the run.

acceptance.arms: Baseline: ATTOCODE_LOCAL_ONLY=1, default deterministic ranking, delivery must be stable. Candidate: provider systemone, endpoint https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, model typesafe/jev-1.13, timeout 1500 ms, remote opt-in for the pinned source only.
acceptance.samples: Three samples per page. A candidate label counts only if all three samples deliver it (worst of 3).
acceptance.gain: First-five judged files: net gain >= 3 overall, with a positive net in >= 2 repositories.
acceptance.losses: Zero individual file losses at 24, at most one at five; no file or visible-quote total loss on any page; no scoped individual loss; no net inspection loss.
acceptance.fallback: At most 5% of rerank attempts (responses with rerank_elapsed_ms) fall back. Any configuration fallback (not_configured, invalid_config, remote_disabled, missing_credential) fails the trial.
acceptance.latency: Rerank p95 <= 1.5 s; search p95 <= 2.0 s over every page-5 and page-24 sample.
acceptance.cost: Estimated spend (rerank calls x $0.00075) and measured key usage delta both <= $5. The OpenRouter key has a $5 credit limit.
acceptance.limitation: Rerank stays opt-in and off by default whatever the result. A pass recommends the hosted opt-in in docs; a fail keeps it experimental.
